gloss: nasal sound change (to ん in verb forms)

definitions.gloss: nasal euphonic change; change to ん
definitions.explanation: A grammar term for the sound change in which a syllable becomes the moraic nasal ん before て and た. It is why godan verbs ending in む, ぶ and ぬ form their て-form with んで: {読|よ}む → {読|よ}んで, {遊|あそ}ぶ → {遊|あそ}んだ, {死|し}ぬ → {死|し}んで.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{撥音便|はつおんびん}だ。
examples.english: Yonde is a nasal sound change.

examples.japanese: む、ぶ、ぬで{終|お}わる⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{撥音便|はつおんびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Verbs ending in mu, bu and nu undergo the nasal sound change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{撥音便|はつおんびん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{促音便|そくおんびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese class, we learned the difference between the nasal and the geminate sound changes.

notes:
One of the four kinds of ⟦{音便|おんびん}→音便：30843_onbin⟧ (euphonic change) taught in Japanese school grammar. Classical ⟦{読|よ}みて→読む：00426_yomu⟧ became modern ⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧, with the て voiced to で after ん.

TYPES:
- {撥音便|はつおんびん}: to ん (⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ → ⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧)
- {促音便|そくおんびん}: to small っ (⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ → ⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧)
- イ⟦{音便|おんびん}→音便：30843_onbin⟧: to い (⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ → ⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧)
- ウ⟦{音便|おんびん}→音便：30843_onbin⟧: to う (ありがたく → ⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧)
